plan.intro.text: The weekly plan of a season part: when each resource is open for trainings, optionally for an age range and a number of teams. Slots may overlap.

plan.no_seasons.text: There is no season part to plan yet.

plan.read_only.text: Admins and managers edit the plan; you see it read only.

plan.no_resources.text: There is no active resource to plan.

plan.add_help.text: Click an empty spot of a resource column to add a slot; drag a slot to move it, or its bottom edge to change its end. Open a slot to set ages and the team limit.

plan.add_help_week.text: Click an empty spot of a resource column to add a slot for the shown week only; drag a slot to move it, or its bottom edge to change its end. Open a slot to set ages, the team limit, or both weeks.

plan.columns_help.text: The grid shows up to eight resources at once.

plan.warning.capacity.text: {resource}, {day} {from}–{to}: slots allow {teams} teams at once, the resource takes {limit}.

plan.slots_empty.text: There are no slots in this plan yet.

plan.slot_ages_help.text: Ages in years; leave empty for no limit.

plan.slot_max_teams_help.text: How many teams may train in the slot; empty is no limit. Without a limit the slot counts as one team in capacity warnings.

plan.copy_intro.text: Start this part from an earlier plan: the copy keeps weekday, time, resource, ages, and team limit, and replaces this part's slots. You can copy again at any time.

plan.copy.replace.one: Replace the {count} slot of this part
plan.copy.replace.other: Replace the {count} slots of this part

plan.copy_none.text: There is no earlier part to copy from.

plan.copy.skipped_archived.one: {count} slot on an archived resource was not copied.
plan.copy.skipped_archived.other: {count} slots on archived resources were not copied.

plan.copy.merged.one: This part has no A/B weeks: {count} duplicate slot was copied once.
plan.copy.merged.other: This part has no A/B weeks: {count} duplicate slots were copied once.

plan.error.invalid_change.text: That change does not fit the plan. Try again.

plan.error.resource_not_found.text: Choose a resource of the group.

plan.error.resource_archived.text: This resource is archived. Choose an active resource.

plan.error.invalid_week.text: Choose week A, week B, or every week. A/B weeks need a part with alternating weeks.

plan.error.invalid_time.text: Enter a start before the end, within one day.

plan.error.invalid_ages.text: Enter ages from 1 to 99, the minimum not above the maximum.

plan.error.invalid_max_teams.text: Enter a team limit from 1 to 99, or leave it empty.

plan.error.full.text: This plan has the most slots a part can hold.

plan.error.invalid_copy.text: Choose another season part to copy from.

plan.error.copy_confirm.text: Confirm that the copy replaces this part's slots.
